map.单因素方差分析（One-way ANOVA）在线计算器，输入多组样本自动计算组间: One-way ANOVA (one-way ANOVA) online calculator: enter several sample groups to automatically compute the between/within sums of squares, the F value and the p value, and judge the significance of the mean differences, running entirely in the front end.
map.F = MS_between / MS_within；MS = SS / df: F = MS_between / MS_within; MS = SS / df
map.单因素方差分析把总变异分解为组间（因素引起）与组内（随机误差）两部分：MS_be: One-way ANOVA splits the total variation into between-group (caused by the factor) and within-group (random error) parts: MS_between = SS_between/(k-1), MS_within = SS_within/(N-k), and F is the ratio of the two. A larger F means the between-group difference is more significant relative to the within-group fluctuation, and it tests whether several group means are equal.
map.填写「组1标准差」。: Enter the standard deviation of group 1.
map.填写「组2标准差」。: Enter the standard deviation of group 2.
map.填写「组3标准差」。: Enter the standard deviation of group 3.
map.填写「组1样本量」。: Enter the sample size of group 1.
map.填写「组2样本量」。: Enter the sample size of group 2.
map.填写「组3样本量」。: Enter the sample size of group 3.
map.比较多组均值：F=MSB/MSW。: Comparing means across several groups: F = MSB/MSW.
map.原假设\"各组均值相等\"。: The null hypothesis "all group means are equal".
map.显著后做两两比较（Tukey 等）。: After significance, run pairwise comparisons (Tukey and similar).
map.：组间 SSB、组内 SSW，MSB=SSB/dfB、MSW=SSW/dfW；如: Compute SSB and SSW, with MSB = SSB/dfB and MSW = SSW/dfW; for example MSB=30 and MSW=15 gives F=2.0 with df=(2,27). The critical F(0.05; 2, 27) is about 3.35, so it is not significant.
map.：F=5.0：超过临界，拒绝\"均值相等\"，至少一组不同。: F=5.0: above the critical value, reject "equal means"; at least one group differs.
map.ANOVA 显著后干嘛？: What to do after ANOVA is significant?
map.需事后检验（Tukey HSD、Bonferroni）定位哪两组不同，避免多重比: Post-hoc tests (Tukey HSD, Bonferroni) are needed to locate which two groups differ, avoiding false positives from multiple comparisons.
map.F 大一定有意义？: Does a large F always matter?
map.F 大且 p 小说明组间差异显著，但效应大小（η²）才反映实际重要性。: A large F with a small p means the between-group difference is significant, but the effect size (eta-squared) is what reflects practical importance.
